Tune into ‘Tera Mera Rishta Continues (Film Ballad) from ‘Awarapan 2’. A heartfelt melody about love, hope, and never giving up, this beautiful track is recreated and rearranged by Mithoon. It features Emraan Hashmi and Disha Patani in the video.
